svg.title: From the walk to a written answer
svg.desc: GraphRAG runs DecisionWalkRetriever, which walks from Christopher Nolan to his movies and their genres with four decisions. GraphRAG puts the eight results, each with its path, into a prompt with the question, and one LLM call writes the answer.
svg.text: From the walk to a written answer
Question: “What genres are the movies that Christopher Nolan directed?”
... and 6 more lines, one for each genre
What genres are the movies that
Each result is one line: the node,
its labels and the path that reached it.
One LLM call. The LLM writes the answer
from the context and does not search
